verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸਚਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪੰਜੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: nihachal sachaa theh hai saadhasa(n)g pa(n)je paradhaanaa|

en.bdb: The city in the form of holy congregation is true and immovable because in it reside all the five chiefs (virtues).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਭੋ ਬੰਧਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath samarath sabho ba(n)dhaanaa|

en.bdb: Truth, contentment, compassion, dharma and lucre are capable of all control.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes kamaavanaa gurmukh naam dhaan isanaanaa|

en.bdb: Here, the gurmukhs practise the teachings of the Guru and observe meditation on ram, charity and ablution.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਣ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਗਿਆਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhen bhagat guragiaanaa|

en.bdb: People speak sweet here, walk humbly, give away charities and attain knowledge through devotion to the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਰਾਈ ਸੁਰਖੁਰੂ ਸਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜੈ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuhee saraiee surakhuroo sach sabadh vajai neesaanaa|

en.bdb: They remain free from any anxiety in this world and the world hereafter, and for them, the drums of true

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਲਣੁ ਜਿੰਨ੍ਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆਂ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਮਿਹਮਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: chalan ji(n)nhee jaaniaa(n) jag a(n)dhar virale mihamaanaa|

en.bdb: Word are struck upon. Rare are the guests who have accepted the going away from this world, as true.
I am sacrifice unto them who have eschewed their ego.
